title: A Reinforcement Learning-based Offensive semantics Censorship System for Chatbots

bias_targets.target: Offensive Language and Hate Speech (including Racial Bias)
bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the probability of a chatbot generating offensive responses (P_offensive) by using an automated text classification model (Bi-GRU with attention) to detect violent, dangerous, and contextually offensive semantics. The evaluation is conducted on datasets containing reactionary/racist statements (Nazi Tweets) and conversational profanity (SimSimi), comparing output rates before and after applying a reinforcement learning-based purification algorithm.
